US.description: Covers essential living costs such as groceries, utilities, transportation, healthcare, and leisure activities, excluding housing costs.

IN.description: Covers groceries, local transportation, utilities, and basic leisure activities for a single person.

SG.description: Generally high, especially for dining out, entertainment, and imported goods. Public transport is efficient and relatively affordable, and local groceries can help manage costs.

CH.description: Cost of living for goods and services is very high, particularly for groceries, dining out, and transportation.

NL.description: High costs for groceries, dining out, utilities, and public transportation.

GB.description: Groceries, transportation, utilities, and daily expenses.

CA.description: Covers expenses such as groceries, transportation, utilities, dining out, and other personal care and leisure activities, representing a moderate lifestyle.

AE.description: Cost of living for groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure in major cities like Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

NO.description: Norway has a high cost of living, with groceries, transportation, and dining out being notably expensive, consistent with other Nordic countries.

IE.description: Cost of living for groceries, utilities, transportation, and discretionary spending is high, especially in Dublin.

LU.description: Overall high cost of living excluding rent, particularly for groceries, utilities, and dining out. Public transport is free throughout the country.

AU.description: Covers groceries, utilities, public transport, and moderate entertainment/personal expenses for an individual.

QA.description: Cost of living for groceries, dining, and transportation is moderate to high, with utilities generally affordable.

BN.description: Cost of living is moderate, benefiting from subsidized utilities and fuel, though prices for imported goods can be higher.

MO.description: High cost of living for daily expenses, groceries, and dining, with local food options being more affordable than imported goods.
